name: bc-security-core
description: Read-only security review agent, report format and optional hooks for the bc-security marketplace.

hook_sensitive_edits.title: Notify on sensitive edits
hook_sensitive_edits.description: Show a notice suggesting a security review after Claude edits a security-sensitive file (auth, secrets, Docker, CI, dependency manifests, skills, hooks).

hook_pre_commit.title: Ask before git commit
hook_pre_commit.description: Ask for confirmation before a git commit so you can run a security review of the staged changes first. Never blocks the commit.

save_automatic_reports.title: Save automatic reports
save_automatic_reports.description: Ask to save the report under .security/reports/ after every review, not only explicit ones.
